summary: Phase 3 adversarial re-probe of check-rework.sh at cddadba3, with eight new probes beyond the Review A fixture set (reused shot, sha mismatch, el 60, anthropic judge, hy judge, second rerate, 6.9 accepted, cell-record mismatch were already falsified and are not repeated as gate probes). A real git fixture under /tmp/opencode/adv-p3-civic reproduces the committed records with a faithful history (base c0, rework commit c1 touching scenes/maps/mill.ts and both shots, records c2, checker c3, rerate audited_head = c1) and the control passes 39 of 39, so every probe counts. Six probes are caught: a rework commit on an unmerged side branch fails with 3 FAILs (P3-a 'is not an ancestor of HEAD' plus both P3-b recency FAILs); a rerate log whose model_id names glm-5.3 while the route model is kimi-for-coding fails the exact compare Red added for the Phase 2 ADV-4 class; a rework record for bank, whose Phase 2 judge rating is 7.5 with critical false, fails with 4 FAILs led by 'reworked map bank is not below the bar'; an inventory Rerate cell of 5.0 against the record's 7.5 fails the P3-e compare; a row marked accepted with Rerate 7.5 while the rerate record holds critical true fails 'wants state [follow-up]'; and the 3q elevation boundary behaves exactly as specified, with 45.0 and 50.0 passing 39 of 39 and 44.9 failing 'lies outside [45, 50]'. Two probes confirm checker gaps with no live instance, routed to Red as ADV-5 and ADV-6: P3-a verifies the rework commit resolves and is an ancestor of HEAD but never that it touches its source_paths (a c1 that changed only the shots and a stray file passes 39 of 39), and P3-c verifies the rerate audited_head is an ancestor of HEAD but never that it is a descendant of the rework commit (audited_head = the phase-base commit, which predates the rework, passes 39 of 39, so a rerate that judged the pre-rework tree would pass). Both gaps are future drift only: git show --name-only proves the committed rework commit 7619c491 touches scenes/maps/mill.ts, and git merge-base --is-ancestor proves the committed audited_head 304a75d6 descends from 7619c491, so the mill acceptance rests on faithful records; review-a independently verified the same two facts. No blocking finding, no live contract violation, and no test-strategy violation exists, so the phase gate stands and the two hardening items route to Red.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-5 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-rework.sh P3-a (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-rework.sh:170-179) verifies that the rework commit resolves and is an ancestor of HEAD but never verifies that the commit touches the source_paths it claims (no git show/diff on the commit against .source_paths). Fixture proof: ADV-P3-01 builds a git fixture whose rework commit c1 touches only the two shots and docs/stray.txt and never touches scenes/maps/mill.ts (git show --name-only on c1 minus the source path is empty), and the unmodified checker passes 39 of 39 with exit 0. No live instance exists: git show --name-only --format= 7619c491 lists docs/map-mockups/mill-3q.png, docs/map-mockups/mill-top.png, and scenes/maps/mill.ts, so the committed record is faithful and the exposure is future drift only. Red can close it by requiring each rework record's commit to have a non-empty diff for every entry in source_paths, without weakening the existing recency defense.

ADV-6 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-rework.sh P3-c (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-rework.sh:331-338) verifies that the rerate audited_head is an ancestor of HEAD but never that it is a descendant of (or equal to) the rework commit, so the gate cannot tell whether the judge saw the reworked shots. Fixture proof: ADV-P3-03 sets the rerate audited_head to the fixture phase-base commit c0, which resolves and is an ancestor of HEAD while the rework commit c1 is not an ancestor of c0 (git merge-base --is-ancestor c1 c0 fails, so the judge saw the pre-rework tree), and the unmodified checker passes 39 of 39 with exit 0. No live instance exists: the committed audited_head 304a75d6c9a97064e84f4ea5eec54b67ca5daa86 satisfies git merge-base --is-ancestor 7619c491 304a75d6 (true), so the mill rerate did judge the reworked tree; review-c verified the same. Red can close it with one added ancestry check (rework commit is an ancestor of audited_head) inside the existing P3-c loop, where both SHAs are already in hand.

ADV-P3-08 (elevation boundary, exact): fixtures t08a (el 45.0) and t08b (el 50.0) each pass 39 of 39 with exit 0, and t08c (el 44.9) fails with 'FAIL: P3-b mill 3q elevation [44.9] lies outside [45, 50]'. The band edges are inclusive as the strategy requires (test-strategy.md:155).

No live instance for either gap: git show --name-only --format= 7619c491 lists docs/map-mockups/mill-3q.png, docs/map-mockups/mill-top.png, and scenes/maps/mill.ts, so the committed rework commit did touch the map source; git merge-base --is-ancestor 7619c491 304a75d6 exits 0, so the committed rerate audited_head 304a75d6 postdates the rework commit; jq -r .audited_head rerate-mill.json prints 304a75d6c9a97064e84f4ea5eec54b67ca5daa86, equal to the log line. The mill acceptance therefore rests on records that are faithful in the committed tree, which is why both gaps are Nit hardening items routed to Red rather than blockers.
